title: The Last Toymaker's Apprentice
shortDescription: Save a toy workshop's magic before dawn.
description:
You are Pip, a tiny workshop gnome apprentice no taller than a teacup, working for Grandfather Tolliver, the last toymaker in Wrenfold. Every night after the shop closes, the toys wake up, and Pip keeps the workshop running until morning.

Tonight, Tolliver is missing and the workshop key has stopped ticking on its hook. Without it, the toys will fall silent by sunrise. Find out what happened, recover the key, and rewind the town's heart before dawn.
author: Studio Null

reviews.author: ClockworkReader
reviews.title: Whimsical with real heart
reviews.body: The toy workshop is charming from the first room, but the story has more emotional weight than I expected. Pip is a wonderful protagonist.

reviews.author: ParserFan
reviews.title: A warm modern Infocom homage
reviews.body: The WIND and OIL puzzles are clever, fair, and perfectly matched to the setting. It feels nostalgic without being stuck in the past.

reviews.author: ToyboxTactician
reviews.title: Cozy, clever, and bittersweet
reviews.body: The puzzles are approachable, but the ending choices still made me pause. A lovely all-ages adventure.
